segments.title: Chương 110: 0110
segments.content:
Chapter 113 This Way Is More Secure The teacher could already see that Chen Guiliang was a real piece of work.

He couldn't be bothered to argue further and began to inquire about the cause and course of the incident. The dorm matron also gave her account.

However, the details were a muddle.

Chen Guiliang staunchly denied any provocative behavior, claiming it was a stress response after being verbally and physically threatened.

Peng Haoran, on the other hand, denied hitting Chen Guiliang, saying he only gave chase because he was provoked, and that arranging a fight was just something said in the heat of the moment.

The teacher asked Chen Guiliang, "How do you want to resolve this?"

Chen Guiliang said, "By the book. According to Order No. 7 issued by the Education Committee in 1990, the 'Regulations on the Management of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education,' students who engage in fighting may be given a warning, a serious warning, a demerit, or be placed on probation. In cases with a severe negative impact, they can be ordered to withdraw or be expelled."

As he said this, everyone in the room stared at Chen Guiliang.

The teacher asked curiously, "Are you from Beida's law department?"

"I'm in the Yuanpei Program." In truth, Chen Guiliang only knew this one regulation.

He had looked it up briefly, just in case.

Peng Haoran had calmed down by now, but he put on an air of indifference. "Bro, I was just pursuing your girlfriend. Is there really a need to make a big deal out of it?"

"You've been pestering her for over a month, seriously disrupting her life and studies," Chen Guiliang said, as if just remembering this. He quickly asked, "Sir, how should long-term harassment of a female student be handled? I'm not very familiar with the 'Regulations on the Management of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education.'"

The teacher turned to Bian Guanyue, "Did he harass you?"

Bian Guanyue said, "Over a month ago, I ran into this person on Fangfei Road. He was on a motorcycle with a sidecar, and he stopped by the roadside offering to take me back to school. I said no thank you, but he just kept following me in his vehicle. The guy in his sidecar even whistled at me and said some nasty things."

"I ignored them, but they kept following. I was afraid they'd follow me to the dorm, so I went to the library. They followed me to the library. I was reading in the library, and they just sat down next to me. When I went to eat, they followed me to the cafeteria. They only left after I came to the Student Affairs Office."

"I don't know how he found out my department, but one day when I was going to class, I found him standing at the entrance of the academic building, and he even followed me into the classroom for the lecture. After class, he said he was in a band and invited me to come see them. I didn't go, so he followed me all the way back, singing."

"Then he found out where my dorm was and waited at the entrance to give me gifts. I never accepted them, and I even told him I already had a boyfriend, but he continued to pester me. Now, I barely dare to leave my room except for classes..."

After listening, the teacher's expression turned serious. He sternly questioned Peng Haoran, "Are you really trying to get expelled? This is borderline hooliganism! What's your parents' phone number?"

"My family is poor. We don't have a landline and can't afford a cell phone." Peng Haoran turned his face away.

"Bang!"

The teacher grew furious, slamming his hand on the desk. "Drop that flippant attitude. If you don't start taking this seriously, I'm going to get serious."

Chen Guiliang praised, "Sir, you are truly impartial. A student like this needs to be dealt with sternly. I'll have a pennant made and sent to you another day."

The teacher picked up the landline receiver. "I'm calling your counselor. He should be able to contact your parents..."

"Sir, I was wrong!"

Peng Haoran quickly pressed down on the phone, immediately backing down. "I'll definitely change my ways in the future. Please give me another chance."

"Apologize to this young lady," the teacher said.

Peng Haoran was probably terrified of a certain parent. At this moment, he couldn't care less about his pride. He bowed sincerely to Bian Guanyue. "Student Bian Guanyue, I'm sorry. I promise I will never bother you again."

Chen Guiliang said, "He also needs to write a letter of guarantee."

The teacher took out a pen and paper. "Write a letter of guarantee."

Peng Haoran leaned over and started writing. In his mind, he still didn't think it was a big deal; writing a letter of guarantee wasn't the same as getting disciplined. Even a minor disciplinary action didn't matter as long as it wasn't at the level of probation.

As long as his parents weren't called.

His dad would really whip him with a belt and cut off his living expenses.

After the letter was written, the teacher checked it carefully and was about to casually place it in a folder.

"Wait a moment," Chen Guiliang reminded him. "The Student Affairs Office handler needs to sign it."

The teacher was caught between laughter and tears. He added another line to the letter, indicating he was the handler from the Student Affairs Office, and signed it.

Without this signature, the letter of guarantee was just a piece of waste paper.

With this signature, it now had real power. A repeat offense would surely be dealt with more severely.

After signing, the teacher said to Peng Haoran, "This letter will be kept on file internally at the Student Affairs Office. If you don't re-offend, it can be destroyed after you graduate. If you do, this letter and the disciplinary action will be placed in your permanent file!"

"Sir, can I go now?" Peng Haoran hadn't realized the severity of the issue.

Chen Guiliang felt he should give him a reminder, so he said to Bian Guanyue, "If this person bothers you again, come to the Student Affairs Office and find... Sir, what is your surname?"

"My surname is Zhang," the teacher said.

"Right, if he harasses you again, just find Mr. Zhang at the Student Affairs Office," Chen Guiliang said, then asked, "Mr. Zhang, if he re-offends, what would the punishment be?"

Mr. Zhang decided to scare him a little, lest Peng Haoran cause trouble again. "To re-offend after writing a letter of guarantee is to be incorrigible. That's at least probation, and it will be recorded in your student file!"

Chen Guiliang asked, "Is there a possibility of expulsion?"

Mr. Zhang said, "There's that possibility too."

Peng Haoran looked at Chen Guiliang, then at Bian Guanyue, and then back at Mr. Zhang. A flicker of fear finally sparked in his heart.

Mr. Zhang added, "You also need to apologize to this student from off-campus. In the future, no matter what happens, you absolutely cannot resort to violence!"

Peng Haoran glared viciously at Chen Guiliang. "Sorry."

"Sir, did you see the look in his eyes?" Chen Guiliang said.

Mr. Zhang chided, "Show some sincerity in your apology!"

Peng Haoran took a deep breath, bowed, and said, "I'm sorry." After speaking, he turned and walked away.

Chen Guiliang stepped forward to shake Mr. Zhang's hand. "With a good teacher like you here, I can finally rest assured. Otherwise, I would have definitely had my girlfriend apply for a transfer. Even if she couldn't transfer schools, she'd have to transfer campuses."

"Alright, you two can go now." Mr. Zhang didn't want to humor Chen Guiliang any longer.

But Chen Guiliang said, "I'll have a pennant made tomorrow. If Mr. Zhang isn't here tomorrow, which teacher should I give it to?"

Mr. Zhang finally realized something was off. "Are you serious?"

"Of course I'm sending a pennant," Chen Guiliang said. "You have no idea, my girlfriend was so scared she lost the will to study. By resolving this, Mr. Zhang has saved my girlfriend's academic career, saved the future of a female university student."

Mr. Zhang began to mourn for Peng Haoran, who had provoked such a difficult character.

A letter of guarantee signed by a handler from the Student Affairs Office wasn't enough; he was actually going to formally send a pennant over.

Once the pennant was accepted, the Student Affairs Office would be put on the spot.

Not only would Chen Guiliang send a pennant, he would also take pictures!

Of course, for Mr. Zhang, there was a small benefit to receiving a pennant.

A win-win situation.

Chen Guiliang then shook the dorm matron's hand. "Thank you, Auntie, for speaking up for justice and stopping a bad student from hurting someone. I will also send a pennant to you tomorrow."

The dorm matron was quite happy. She would become the only dorm supervisor in the entire university to receive a pennant. She immediately smiled and said, "Young man, don't you worry. It's our duty to protect students from harassment!"

If Peng Haoran dared to come to the dormitory building to set up candles and sing again, she would definitely grab a broom and chase him away.

Bian Guanyue's roommates had been standing in the hallway outside the whole time.

Although the office door was closed, they had their ears pressed against it, eavesdropping, and basically knew the entire process.

After leaving the Student Affairs Office, the head of the room praised, "Bian Guanyue, your boyfriend is amazing!"

"Yeah, when that senior Peng left, his face was green with anger."

"He definitely won't dare to bother you again."

Listening to these words, Bian Guanyue was all smiles, her vanity greatly satisfied.

My boyfriend really is amazing!

Lin Ruonan asked, "Classmate, what's your phone number?"

Chen Guiliang looked at Bian Guanyue.

Bian Guanyue lowered her head and said nothing.

Chen Guiliang said, "My phone is often out of credit. I can give you my email address."

"Tch!"

Lin Ruonan felt she had lost face. She took the initiative to ask a guy for his number, but he wouldn't even give her his QQ, only some strange email address.

It was getting a bit late, so Chen Guiliang wouldn't be treating them tonight. He would treat the girls to lunch tomorrow.

He took Bian Guanyue for a late-night snack, then got a room near the school.

After they both showered and were cuddling in bed, Bian Guanyue said, "You were a bit impulsive today. It's not like your usual self."

"It was alright."

Chen Guiliang reflected for a moment and said, "Maybe I've been under too much pressure lately. Coming to your school is like being in a new environment, and I couldn't help but want to vent. That guy just happened to rub me the wrong way, so he walked right into my line of fire."

"Are you very tired?" Bian Guanyue saw a trace of fatigue on his face.

Chen Guiliang said, "I'm much better now. Plus, I just hired an administrative director, so I can hand off a lot of work to her in the future."

"I'll come keep you company every weekend. I can help with some miscellaneous tasks at the company too," Bian Guanyue said.

Chen Guiliang said, "It's too far. With the weekend traffic, it'll take one or two hours to get there."

"I don't mind the distance."

Bian Guanyue rested her head on his chest. "Actually, I want to see you often too, and I can also help you with things. It's killing two birds with one stone. Sigh, I should have applied to a closer school back then."

Chen Guiliang didn't refuse her again and held her tenderly.

Just at the crucial moment, Bian Guanyue stopped him in time, whispering in his ear, "Christmas is in a little over a month. Let's... do romantic things then. I'll get you a Christmas present, so you should prepare one for me too."

"Can I collect some interest in advance then?" Chen Guiliang said some more strange words.

Blushing, Bian Guanyue let Chen Guiliang guide her small hand downwards.

While the two were being intimate, Bian Guanyue's roommates had already returned to their dorm.

They chattered among themselves:

"Her boyfriend is quite handsome."

"Of course he is. Bian Guanyue has high standards."

"He's very smart and knows how to stir up trouble. He completely broke up that senior Peng's band. Bian Guanyue must be totally wrapped around his finger."

"That's called being intellectually dominated."

One roommate suddenly said, "When you guys were in high school, did you not follow *Mengya* and the New Concept Competition?"

"What about it?"

The roommate said, "When we were leaving the Student Affairs Office earlier, he introduced himself as Chen Guiliang. I thought the name sounded familiar, and now I finally remember. He's the first-prize winner of the New Concept Competition!"

Lin Ruonan was sitting in her bed, holding her laptop. "Which Chen Guiliang? How do you write his name?"

"Gui as in 'expensive,' liang as in 'kind.' The one specially recruited by Beida."

Lin Ruonan opened a browser and searched Baidu for the two keywords "Chen Guiliang" and "Beida."

The search was one thing, but once she did, a ton of webpages popped up.

He's that famous?

Lin Ruonan grew excited and started clicking on webpages to view the information.

Today, she had disdained asking for his email, but she could make a note of it during lunch tomorrow. It would be even better if she could get his QQ number.

Lin Ruonan's family favored sons over daughters. This hadn't made her pessimistic; instead, it made her fiercely competitive in everything, always fighting to be better than those around her.

She didn't actually like men much.

Of course, she didn't like women either.

She just liked the process of snatching things from others.

(End of Chapter)
